description: The EoE fragment reassembly code uses a frame size from the wire as the bound for memcpy into the application receive buffer, without checking that the declared size fits in the actual buffer. A master can write up to 2016 bytes into a buffer the application may have sized much smaller.

When the last EoE fragment has the TIME_APPEND flag set, the handler subtracts 4 from rxframeoffset to strip the timestamp. There is no check that rxframeoffset is at least 4.
